items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998

ctx.x: Yes. In Long Beach State College. And the jazz station, they play all day long and night, 24 hours, and they’re I guess on the satellite and they go all over the country. Every time I turn them on they’re playing the blues.

So you know I was so happy that — I live out in the desert, the high desert, and gee we’ve got cable, and which we got cable FM along with it. And then they got KLON on the cable, oh this is great. I’ll be able to hear what guys are doing. I think it’s the most accessible kind of jazz you know, blues. I don’t know what other excuse they have. I’m too general, but enough that I don’t even turn it on. And then of course what’s considered jazz today, whatever they call new age jazz or contemporary, on the Black…
